scope: Read-only exploratory inspection of unfiltered native-rate EDF samples; no connectivity calculations or production changes

method.channel_selection: Twelve evenly spaced positions in each existing Zarr calculated electrode list; unique normalized EDF matches
method.segment_placement: 20 seconds after start, centered, ending 20 seconds before end
method.threshold_caveat: Exploratory peak-to-local-background screening heuristic, not a statistical line-noise detector
method.linewidth_caveat: Finite Welch resolution and time-varying amplitude/frequency affect apparent widths

candidate_notch_check.scope: Exploratory notch comparison on seven patients; middle 60-second native-rate clips, trim 10 seconds per end for PSD comparison
candidate_notch_check.interpretation: A notch removes signal as well as noise inside its stopband; background checks are only 3–6 Hz away from each notch. This is not validation of all connectivity metrics or the final preparation chain.

example_bandpass_response.design: MNE FIR defaults: zero phase, Hamming, firwin, automatic transitions
example_bandpass_response.status: Illustration of transition-band leakage, not an agreed final bandpass design
